official.deadline_note: Institutional deadlines differ within the same call: 19 October 2026 for UNIR Maestrias Oficiales / Grados Oficiales and EP NEWMAN; 26 October 2026 for UNIR Mexico; 30 October 2026 for UNIR Formacion Permanente. Selected candidates are published from November 2026.
official.status_note: The 2a convocatoria (Otono 2026) is open with deadlines of 19, 26 and 30 October 2026 depending on institution and programme; the 1a convocatoria (Primavera 2026) deadlines of 16 March to 10 April 2026 are closed.
official.tuition_coverage_note: La beca cubrira la reduccion del 40% y 60% de descuento en funcion de la institucion y el programa elegido sobre el costo total de la colegiatura y es aplicable unicamente al valor del programa de estudios.
benefits: Up to 885 scholarships (cupos) available across UNIR, EP NEWMAN and UNIR Mexico for the 2026 academic course
60% discount on the total tuition (colegiatura) for UNIR Maestrias Oficiales and Grados Oficiales, EP NEWMAN Maestrias Oficiales and UNIR Mexico Maestrias Oficiales
50% discount on the total tuition for UNIR Formacion Permanente programmes
The discount applies only to the value of the study programme
eligibility: Nationality and/or permanent legal residence of any SG/OAS Member State, except Nicaragua
You cannot study in your own country of origin
You must have completed the admission process and been admitted to one of the programmes in the call
You must not have received another OAS academic scholarship at the same level of study
Before starting any programme you must demonstrate financial capacity to cover the programme costs not covered by the scholarship
SG/OAS officials, persons under contract by results with the SG/OAS, Permanent Mission staff and their relatives are not eligible
requirements: Be admitted to one of the programmes listed in the call, evidenced by the institution's application letter (carta de aplicacion)
Pay the admission fee (cuota de admision) required by the institution in order to be admitted
Demonstrate financial capacity to cover the uncovered programme costs before starting
Maintain an average equal to or above 5/10 each academic period and pass all curricular subjects on time
Not be reported with baja academica through absences from the programme and/or failure of subjects
documents: Institution's application letter (carta de aplicacion) issued once the applicant is admitted
Admission documentation required by the institution for the chosen programme
selection_criteria: Academic profile, merit and academic credentials
The applicant's potential impact on completing the study programme
Geographic distribution of candidates according to the most important needs of Member States as reflected in the UNDP Human Development Index
coverage: 60% reduction of the total tuition (colegiatura) for official master's and official degree programmes at UNIR, EP NEWMAN and UNIR Mexico
50% reduction of the total tuition for UNIR Formacion Permanente programmes
Applicable only to the value of the study programme
Admission fees, translation and notarisation or authentication of documents, study materials, titulation and degree-obtaining procedures and any other unlisted expense are not covered
application_method: Follow the admission process for the chosen programme directly with the institution and pay the admission fee

Obtain the institution's application letter (carta de aplicacion) once admitted, which makes the applicant automatically a candidate for the scholarship; there is no separate scholarship application form
Await the specialised committee formed by UNIR, EP NEWMAN, UNIR Mexico and the OAS to select the scholarship holders
Only selected candidates are contacted by email by the institutions with the scholarship offer and acceptance instructions
After accepting, start the corresponding payment procedures with the chosen institution
official.application_route: Apply for admission directly to the participating institution; once admitted and issued the application letter you are automatically a scholarship candidate, with no separate OEA scholarship form.
official.citizenship_residency: Nationality and/or permanent legal residence of any SG/OAS Member State, except Nicaragua; Nicaragua nationals and permanent legal residents are excluded.
official.international_eligibility: Open to nationals and permanent legal residents of OAS Member States (except Nicaragua); applicants cannot study in their own country of origin.
official.subject_or_agency_requirement: Only programmes listed in the call at UNIR (Spain), EP NEWMAN (Peru) and UNIR Mexico; online/distance postgraduate and continuing-education study in Spanish.
official.duration: UNIR Maestrias Oficiales 12 months; UNIR Grados Oficiales 4 years with the degree scholarship applying only to the first teaching year; UNIR Formacion Permanente 21 to 34 weeks; EP NEWMAN Maestrias Oficiales 12 months; UNIR Mexico Maestrias Oficiales 18 or 24 months
official.description: The SG/OAS, through UNIR (Spain), the Escuela de Posgrado Peruana de NEWMAN (Peru) and UNIR Mexico, offers tuition discounts of up to 60% for online postgraduate study to outstanding individuals from the Americas. Up to 885 places are available for the 2026 academic course and the discount applies only to the value of the study programme.

not_confirmed: documents (the call publishes no formal document checklist; only the admission route and application letter are described)
verification.notes: The official 10-page SG/OAS call PDF was downloaded from oas.org and read in full. The benefit is published as a percentage discount on tuition (60% / 50%) rather than as a monetary amount, and the document states that programme costs shown are orientative, so no amount is recorded. The PDF states the fellow covers 40% (Maestrias Oficiales and Grados) or 50% (Formacion Permanente) of the total programme cost and that selection is for 'los sesenta becados' in the process description, while the cover page states up to 885 places.

applicant_utility.summary: Get admitted first and the scholarship follows: there is no separate OEA application form, so your only real task is completing UNIR, EP NEWMAN or UNIR Mexico's own admission process, paying their admission fee, and waiting for their application letter. Budget for the share you still owe, which is 40% of total tuition for official master's and degree programmes and 50% for UNIR Formacion Permanente, plus every administrative fee from translation and notarisation to certificates and graduation. Watch the institution-specific deadlines, because UNIR and EP NEWMAN close on 19 October 2026, eight days before UNIR Mexico and eleven before UNIR Formacion Permanente.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Professionals from an OAS Member State (not Nicaragua) who want a Spanish-language online master's and can fund roughly half the tuition themselves without studying in their home country.
application_readiness_checklist: Confirm your target programme is one of those named in the call before paying any admission fee
Check you are not studying in your country of origin, a rule that disqualifies otherwise strong candidates
Get the programme cost in writing from an advisor, since the document warns the printed costs are orientative and may be lower in your country
Prepare proof of financial capacity for the uncovered share before the programme starts
Line up certified translations and notarisation of your documents early, as they are explicitly not covered
common_rejection_risks: Assuming the scholarship application is separate, missing the admission deadline, and arriving with no application letter at all
Being a Nicaraguan national or resident, which is excluded outright
Applying to study in your own country of origin
Having held another OAS scholarship at the same level
Dropping below a 5/10 average or being reported academically dropped, which can trigger repayment of the scholarship value
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: 40% of total tuition for official master's and degree programmes (50% for Formacion Permanente), plus admission fee, translation and notarisation, study materials, titulation and degree procedures, certificates, and any other unlisted expense.
document_audit: The application letter from the institution is the trigger for your candidacy, so chase it if admission confirmation is slow

The call refers to a 'Responsabilidades del Becario' section on page 27, but the published PDF has only 10 pages, so request the current obligations directly from the institution or Scholarships@oas.org
The SG/OAS reserves the right to cancel the announcement at any point in the process, so do not resign from a job or pay non-refundable costs on the strength of the award
alerts: UNIR Maestrias/Grados and EP NEWMAN close 19 October 2026; UNIR Mexico 26 October; UNIR Formacion Permanente 30 October
Selected candidates are published from November 2026 and only they are contacted, so silence is not a soft rejection you can query
You must commit to working in your country of origin or residence, in an OAS member country, or in an international organisation for at least the length of the scholarship, or repay the funds
Neither the OAS nor the institutions take responsibility for recognition, legalisation, homologation or convalidacion of the resulting title in your country
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Admission at the institution, automatic candidacy via the application letter, specialised committee selection, results at www.oea.org/becas from November 2026, email offer to selected candidates only, then acceptance and payment procedures.
